LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.label: PNA Addiction
LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.description: The nervous system has become dependent on purple nanofluid, keeping sex drive elevated. Withdrawal further heightens sex drive, reduces manipulation, increases sexual vulnerability and causes severe distress. Addiction gradually fades over time; full recovery takes about 10 days without further exposure. Another dose deepens addiction and relieves withdrawal. Exposure at terminal load deepens existing addiction further. This state belongs to the current body; it does not transfer with a personality or pass to a clone.
